PEG.js is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2016 to 2017.

What it was for: [Libraries](@/projects/libraries.md) (1) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [peg-loader](@/work/peg-loader.md): Peg.js grammar loader; [peg-parser](@/work/peg-parser.md): Parser built using peg.js.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses PEG.js: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links PEG.js to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
